3661-5006-8170-8227.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-8170-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
3661-5006-8170-8227.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Loot by sacrificing Shield Sphere, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

1981-2415-7818-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-7818-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2701-3168-6072-7182.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Urza's Incubator
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-3476-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7768.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-5708.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

254-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7706.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the White Widow trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

779-2178-4050-5572-7409.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four land cards in your graveyard.
779-2178-4050-5572-7409.description:
Activate Lluwen by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}, tapping it and discarding Dakmor Salvage, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token for each land card in your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Wurms, adding {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}.
When the Wurms die, Dragon Appeasement and Lluwen trigger five times each.
Resolve all Lluwen triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the first Dragon Appeasement trigger, instead choosing to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Dragon Appeasement triggers, drawing as many cards as desired.
Repeat.
779-2178-4050-5572-7409.notes: As you mill cards, inevitably more lands will end up in your graveyard, meaning you'll make more tokens over time.

4017-4659-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4659-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2034-3375-4871-5497-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Immortal Sun.
Repeat.

4331-4908-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

359-372-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-7095.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-4676-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2079-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2919-4186-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-4716.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

191-392-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-392-6625.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

4002-4067-4823-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4067-4823-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

880-4871-6529.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4222-4289-6210.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Neerdiv.
4222-4289-6210.notablePrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4289-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

2493-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Archaeomancer.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Archaeomancer.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Archaeomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

152-486-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {7}.
152-486-2792.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's last ability by tapping it, making Great Whale an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, making a token copy of Great Whale and giving it haste.
The Great Whale token enters the battlefield, untapping seven lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {7}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2554-3923-5195.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Third Path Iconoclast and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Third Path Iconoclast trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2034-2267-3537-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-2267-3537-4484.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bog Initiate twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3765-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield under your control.

474-565-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target Specimen Collector with the mana to cast it.
474-565-4050.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell from your hand by paying its mana cost, targeting Specimen Collector.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
The Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector, adding one mana of any color.
The nontoken Specimen Collector dies, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector copy.
Repeat from step 3, sacrificing one of the two Specimen Collector copies instead.

776-1444-3717.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
Less mana is required if Viridian Joiner's power is greater than 1.
776-1444-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Elvish Fury with its buyback cost by paying {4}{G}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Viridian Joiner +2/+2 and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.

1540-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1540-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Chalice of the Void by paying {0}.
Chalice of the Void enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Chalice of the Void from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2143-2713.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {2}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
